meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar best pick: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum**—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads, oily skin ya active pimples hain. Iski reported price lagbhag ₹521 hai.[1][2]

**Alternatives:**
- **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Serum** — 2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide; around ₹449–526. Active acne aur oil control ke liye.[1][2]
- **Minimalist 5% Niacinamide** — acne marks, excess oil aur pores ke liye; around ₹399–569. Active pimples ke liye salicylic acid jitna targeted nahi.[7]
- **10% Azelaic Acid serum** — red acne aur dark marks ke liye achha option; Derma Decode variant around ₹587 reported hai.[1]

**Kaise use karein:**  
Raat mein cleanser ke baad **2–3 drops, alternate nights** se start karein; phir moisturizer lagayein. Ek saath salicylic acid, retinol, vitamin C ya doosre strong actives na milayein. Din mein **SPF 30+ sunscreen** zaroor lagayein. Salicylic acid se irritation/dryness ho to frequency kam kar dein.

Agar pimples deep, painful ya cyst-like hain, serum ke bajay dermatologist ko dikhana better hai.[4] Prices offers ke hisaab se badal sakti hain.
